jobs.occupation: Machine operator 2 shift €18,59
jobs.description:
Do you like working with machines and keeping production running smoothly? As a Production Operator in the food industry, you play a key role in ensuring a stable, efficient and safe production process. You work in a modern production environment where teamwork, responsibility and quality matter.

• You start up, operate and adjust production machines throughout the shift.

• You monitor the production process and intervene when adjustments are needed.

• You troubleshoot minor technical issues and contact maintenance when necessary.

• You follow the production planning and keep the process running efficiently.

• You communicate clearly with fellow operators to ensure smooth collaboration.

• You help guarantee production continuity through good organisation and coordination.

• You handle basic administrative tasks related to production.

• You keep your workstation clean, organised and compliant with hygiene and safety rules.

• You have relevant experience as a production or machine operator.

• You are able to work independently and take responsibility for your process.

• You are hands-on, proactive and solution-oriented.

• You have basic technical insight and enjoy working with machines.

• You speak English fluently (no Dutch required for this role, Polish/Romanian is useful).

• You are willing to work in shifts, including early starts (from 3:00 AM) or a fixed afternoon shift.
(A forklift certificate is a plus, but not required.)

jobs.occupation: Bus Mechanic – good salary + training opportunies

Do you enjoy working on vehicles and solving technical problems? In this role as a bus mechanic, you ensure that coaches are safe, reliable and ready for daily operations.

• You carry out maintenance and repairs on buses.

jobs.occupation: Payroll Officer - Zaventem
jobs.description:
In this role, you will be a key partner within the HR organisation, taking ownership of the complete payroll cycle for Belgium and Luxembourg. You combine strong attention to detail with a customer-oriented mindset and actively contribute to improving HR processes.

Client Details

Our client is an international organisation contributing to innovation and sustainable solutions within the industrial sector. To strengthen their HR team, they are looking for a Payroll Officer who will ensure a smooth, accurate and high-quality payroll experience for employees and managers.

Description

As a Payroll Officer, you will be responsible for a broad range of payroll and HR administration activities:

• Managing the end-to-end payroll process for the Belux region, including onboarding, offboarding and employee changes.
• Maintaining and validating payroll data, time registrations, leave balances and absences.
• Preparing payroll payments, performing monthly controls and supporting reconciliations, year-end closing and audits.
• Ensuring accurate and timely processing of social security and legal payroll documentation.
• Preparing payroll reports and acting as a point of contact for employees, managers and internal stakeholders.
• Supporting payroll-related financial reporting processes.
• Contributing to payroll improvement initiatives and HR projects.
• Managing group and health insurance administration, including monthly follow-up and annual evaluations.
• Handling administrative processes such as A1 certificates, American Express requests and meal and eco vouchers.
• Reviewing and approving invoices according to internal control procedures.
• Collaborating closely with external payroll providers, authorities and suppliers while continuously improving processes and documentation.

• You hold a bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Accounting & Taxation or a related field.
• You have several years of payroll experience, preferably within an international environment.
• You have a strong understanding of Belgian social and tax legislation.
• You are proficient in MS Office, especially Excel. Experience with SAP HR, Workday or other payroll systems is a plus.
• You are analytical, detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy working with different stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English, both written and spoken.

jobs.occupation: Talent Acquisition Specialist | HR & Recruitment
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about connecting top talent with exciting career opportunities? This role combines end-to-end recruitment with operational HR support, offering variety, ownership, and direct business impact.

Client Details

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Description

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

• Develop and implement recruitment strategies to attract high-quality talent
• Partner with hiring managers to define hiring needs and ideal candidate profiles
• Source and engage candidates through LinkedIn, job boards, and professional networks
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle, from screening to offer stage
• Build and maintain talent pipelines for future hiring requirements
• Support employer branding initiatives, onboarding activities, and HR projects

A successful Talent Acquisition Specialist should have:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent professional experience
• Initial experience in Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, or Human Resources
• Fluent communication skills in English and French, good level of Dutch
• Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities
• Proactive, organized, and solutions-oriented mindset

jobs.occupation: Customer Service | Czech + English + Eastern-European Language
jobs.description:
Are you a born problem solver with a passion for customer satisfaction? Do you want to work in an international environment where no day is the same? Then we have the perfect challenge for you! At Volvo, they are looking for an enthusiastic customer service representative to join their Central-East team and contribute to their mission of getting vehicles back on the road quickly and efficiently. Your duties: 

 
• Provide first line support for international breakdowns: Wherever our customers are in Europe, you will be there to help them and address their concerns. 
 

 
• Maintain regular contact with dealers and customers: So that everyone is always informed about the progress of repairs. 
 

 
• Working together in a dedicated team: You will be part of a team that is committed 24/7 to providing our customers with the best possible support. 
 Keywords: customer support advisor, customer service, call agent, customer service representative
Bachelor thinking level. Fluent in English + Czech + one of following: Polish, Lithuanian, German (minimum B2 level). 

Flexible in working hours: Working in a full-time system is not a problem for you; rather, you enjoy the variety. Driving license B: You must be able to come to the company independently.

jobs.occupation: Customer Support Advisor: English + German + 1 other European Language
jobs.description:
For our client we're looking for a Customer Service Officer.
In this role, you become the voice of support for drivers facing unexpected vehicle issues across Europe. You'll be part of a fast-paced and multilingual contact center where your communication skills, empathy, and sense of urgency play a crucial role in keeping transport moving.

- Handle incoming assistance requests from international customers experiencing roadside vehicle breakdowns.
- Take ownership of each case by coordinating with local service providers and technicians until the issue is resolved.
- Maintain constant communication with both the customer and service partner, providing regular updates and reassurance.
- Think on your feet and apply a proactive approach to problem-solving, often finding creative solutions under time pressure.
- Be an integral part of a tight-knit, multilingual team that thrives on collaboration and mutual support.
- Operate within a 24/7 environment, where teamwork and flexibility are essential to ensuring seamless customer experiences.

- You speak and write fluently in English, German and at least one other European language.
- You are service-driven and naturally inclined to go the extra mile to support customers in stressful situations.
- Strong interpersonal skills help you adapt your communication style to various cultural and professional contexts.
- You enjoy working in a diverse team setting and are always ready to help others succeed.
- Flexibility to work in a rotating shift schedule, including nights and weekends.
- A hands-on mentality with a structured and solution-oriented mindset.
- Eagerness to continuously develop your skills and embrace new challenges.

jobs.occupation: Warehouse employee
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about transport and logistics? Bleckmann is looking for you! 

We are looking for logistics employees for the Bleckmann warehouses in Rieme and Desteldonk (near Ghent). You will be working in the morning shift (05u48 - 13u48) or late shift (14u00 - 22u00).

This is a temporary assignment during a busy and dynamic peak period. It's a great opportunity to gain experience in logistics. As Bleckmann operates multiple peak periods throughout the year (such as Black Friday in November), you will have the opportunity to return for future assignments.

Are you interested in this opportunity? Be sure to read this vacancy!

Tasks: 

• Preparing incoming orders

• You prepare the orders in order of arrival using a scanning system

• You prepare the correct documents when packing orders

We organize bus transport from Ghent to ensure easy access to Bleckmann:  

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Sint-Pieters for the Rieme warehouse

• Back and forth ride from the station of Gent-Dampoort for the Desteldonk warehouse

• Departure at 5u10 or 13u10

 

• Positive attitude

• Good numerical skills

• Flexibility

• Punctuality

• Fluent in either Dutch, English or French

jobs.occupation: Orderpicker – Night Shift | Earn €20.85 per hour! – Become an essential link at SKF
jobs.description:

SKF, specialized in bearings, seals and lubrication systems, is the place where you contribute to keeping the world running smoothly daily. We are looking for motivated warehouse workers who provide top-quality service to our customers.

jobs.occupation: Handyman / general facilities technician - English is allowed!
jobs.description:
Are you a hands-on technician with solid electrical knowledge and a passion for maintenance, repairs, and problem-solving? Do you enjoy having variety in your work and being the go-to person for all technical issues? And are you already living in Belgium?

For a growing transport and logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for a multi-skilled maintenance technician or handyman to help maintain the buildings, warehouse facilities, technical installations and outdoor areas. A very varied job that combines electrical maintenance, facility maintenance, repairs, troubleshooting and general handyman tasks. And the best part: Dutch isn't required, so you can also apply if you speak English very well!

Your role

As technician, you're responsible for a wide range of maintenance and repair activities across the different sites of the company. You and the rest of the technical team use your technical skills to ensure the operations run safely and efficiently.

Your key duties:

• Perform electrical maintenance and repairs
• Carry out minor repairs to plumbing, storage racks, equipment...
• Keep up the company grounds and outdoor facilities
• Help perform maintenance and repairs to the company vehicles
• Supervise external contractors and service providers

Your profile:

• Good knowledge of electrical systems and installations
• Basic knowledge of plumbing, mechanics, building maintenance, or general technical repairs
• Experience as a maintenance technician, handyman, facilities technician, general maintenance worker...
• Own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
• Very good knowledge of English
 

!! IMPORTANT ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS: please read carefully before applying !!

• You must already be living in Belgium
• You must already have a valid legal right to work in Belgium (EU citizenship or valid work permit)
Candidates who do not meet these requirements will not be considered for the position. We do not provide visa sponsorship, work permits, relocation support or immigration assistance.

jobs.occupation: Customer Service Officer Dutch-Polish-English – Multilingual Support Champion
jobs.description:
Are you ready to join a vibrant, multicultural team that helps people in need every single day? As a Customer Service Officer, you’ll play a key role in ensuring that drivers with broken-down vehicles or trucks get back on the road quickly and safely. You’ll work closely with your team lead and helpful colleagues, gaining exposure to people from diverse backgrounds and learning new skills all the time.

On a typical day, you’ll handle incoming phone calls and emails, respond to customer inquiries, and coordinate with various parties to ensure efficient solutions. You’ll gather information, verify data accuracy, and provide technical support by communicating with workshops. Keeping customers and all involved parties updated is crucial, as is monitoring agreements and following up on contract-related issues within set deadlines. Your work week runs Monday through Friday, with the flexibility to help out on Saturdays during busy periods, and you’ll rotate shifts between 7:00 AM and 10:00 PM.

If you’re passionate about helping others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and enjoy using your language skills every day, we want to hear from you! Apply now to join our team and start making a real impact while growing your career.

• Proficiency in Dutch, Polish, and English (spoken and written); additional languages are a plus

• Strong computer skills, especially with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Outlook)

• Effective telephone communication and interpersonal abilities

• Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Customer- and results-oriented mindset

• High degree of accuracy and attention to detail

• Ability to multitask and stay calm under pressure

• Technical knowledge of automotive or tires is a plus

• No specific previous experience required

• Education at higher secondary, associate, or bachelor’s degree level

• Open to candidates at all career levels: starter, junior, medior, senior, executive
